key_insight: DecoEvo improves text-space optimization by decoupling solver learning from rubric generation, so evolving criteria do not simply become easier for the current solver to satisfy.
engineering_relevance: For LLM adaptation systems that must remain black-box and inspectable, DecoEvo offers a practical way to keep optimization signals aligned with newly exposed weaknesses instead of overfitting to stale evaluation criteria.
method: Update the solver with criterion-level feedback rather than only aggregate scores.
Revise the rubric-generator using complementary audits of requirement coverage and response discrimination.
Avoid using gold rubrics during optimization by separating the objectives for solver skill and rubric quality.
evidence_signal: Under each benchmark's official evaluation, the method outperforms all compared methods across five benchmarks and three LLM backbones, with 2.8–5.0% relative gains over SkillOpt on the five-benchmark average.
watch_item: Decoupled co-evolution still depends on the quality of the criterion-level audits; if those audits miss important dimensions, the system may shift weakness detection rather than fully solve it.
paper_title: DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space
